dataList.content:
Memories and experiences come crashing back in waves:
记忆和经验犹如潮水般涌来。

All of the things that I've been doing here. The reason for the past choices I made in this place.
那是关于我在做什么，以及我为什么做出了这种选择的记忆与经验。

The volume of information is...
这情报量……

*puff* So that's the episode recap.
呼……原来是这种展开。

I wasn't the only one who was going through it.
看来受到影响的并不只有我自己。

The Sinners were all clutching their heads, coming to grips with the sudden resurgence of memories.
罪人们也重新找回了记忆，他们个个都满脸困惑地捂着自己的头。

Outis, seemingly the first to make sense of the situation, turned in my direction.
奥提斯好像是最先弄清楚状况的人，她率先向我提出了问题。

We ought to extol your tireless efforts throughout this ordeal with our utmost awe and praise, Executive Manager. However...
执行经理在此期间历经千辛万苦，尽管我想毫不吝啬地赞美您……

It would seem that the situation at hand must take priority. May I ask whether you have any intelligence concerning the Warden's identity?
但看来我们得优先处理当下的事态了。请问您是否对此人的真面目有些头绪？

<We'd always be returned to the Fount whenever we failed...>
<虽然我们每次失败之后都会回到泉里……>

<But there were times when we were sent back a bit differently.>
<但是，我们偶尔会通过其他方式回到那里。>

... In a manner resembling Liquidation.
……那种方式类似于库存整理。

By way of the false god's shard, ye would elect to forsake your duty than surrender to your punishment with due contrition...?
汝非但不虚心受罚，还用伪神的碎片……背弃自身的义务……

Then that's the one who...
也就是说，那个存在就是……
real choice in the Grand Magasin.> <没错，那就是让我们无法在西西弗百货做出“其他选择”的原因。>

What is your decision, Manager?
您意下如何？

Hearken to me, ye who have sinned...
有罪之人……听好了……

The lot of those who have sinned... is to submit to the order and law as ordained...
有罪之人理应如有罪之人一般……顺应秩序……

<... I have no idea if I'm making the right decision, but...>
<……我不知道这么做到底对不对。>

<... It's time we did something different.>
<但我们得做出不同的选择。>

... Ye shall writhe and suffer... in the pain ye have visited upon yourself...!
并于理所应当的痛苦之中……！挣扎……受苦……！
